# NomiFun v0.6.1

Windows first release for v0.6.1.

## Highlights

- Adds verified native image generation, including durable image artifact delivery and conversation-side rendering for generated image outputs.
- Reworks model and provider management around protocol manifests, explicit provider connections, model capabilities, and task-specific model selection.
- Expands multimodal provider support across image generation/editing, realtime, rerank, speech, video, and embeddings, with new Gemini and StepFun protocol coverage.
- Improves Model Hub and settings workflows for editing model definitions, credentials, health checks, capability disclosure, and serialized writes.
- Unifies browser lifecycle and browser-use settings management, with related presentation and localization refinements.
- Fixes startup issues and improves model type/catalog selection interactions.
